actual_preconditions.permission: workspace-edit mode; no task sent during settings test

attempts.input: Read current appearance and conversation font size settings. Change each reversible setting independently, inspect visible/persisted effect, then restore original values.
actual_steps: Opened Settings > General. Initial theme selection was Follow system with page background rgb(255,255,255); conversation font-size control showed 14px.
Changed theme to Dark. Selected state became Dark and body background changed to rgb(21,21,23).
Closed and reopened Settings. Dark remained selected and body background remained dark; restored Follow system and verified original white background.
In a separate change, increased conversation font size from 14 to 15. Closed and reopened Settings; the displayed value remained 15.

Restored font size to 14 and verified the original value. Computed font-size on an already-rendered unique marker span remained 12px during before/change/restore checks; no new conversation was opened to test whether new content inherits the preference.
attempts.wait_condition: After each control change, wait for UI rerender; close/reopen Settings for persistence readback; restore original values.

checkpoints.observed: Theme selection and white/dark page background were independently confirmed before/after, including persistence across closing and reopening Settings. Font-size control changed 14?15 and persisted across closing/reopening the modal; restoration to 14 was verified. App-restart persistence was not tested.

checkpoints.expected: 不把即时生效当所有设置通则
checkpoints.observed: Theme produced an immediate visible body-background change and persisted on modal reopen. For font-size, only the setting value persistence was confirmed; existing conversation marker computed font remained 12px, so content-size effect is not generalized or verified for new content.

attempts.observed_result: Theme changed immediately (white to rgb(21,21,23)), persisted after reopening Settings, then restored to Follow system (white). Conversation font-size setting changed 14 to 15, persisted after reopening Settings, then restored to 14. Existing conversation marker span remained computed at 12px; effect on newly rendered content remains unverified.
attempts.notes: Only reversible appearance and conversation-font controls were tested. Original values restored: theme Follow system and size 14. Theme background effect is directly observed. Font setting persistence is observed, but existing-message computed text size did not change; a new-session rendering check remains outstanding.

attempts.surface: TPT Work UI via CDP 9234 + Playwright; settings, new tasks, conversation, Browser sidebar, round-owned localhost page

attempts.input: 按有限队列对网页链接目标路由、代码工作工具开关可见效果、繁忙时Queue/Insert提交时序、Ctrl+K搜索触发各做一次有判别力对照；不扩大到其他设置。
actual_steps: 读取初值：应用内侧栏、代码工作工具true、繁忙排队、搜索会话Ctrl+K；模型standard/low。
通过本轮静态HTML链接锚点真实UI点击：应用内侧栏模式加载本轮target；改为默认浏览器后再次点击，相同marker由Chrome请求；随后恢复应用内侧栏并停止localhost服务。
代码工具true时新任务修改本轮JS并通过可见改动卡片打开差异面板；false时另一个新任务修改本轮JS，Trace入口和差异卡片未见，工作区工具仍执行；恢复true。Agent模式切换另有独立disabled gate，未更改。
排队模式下启动本轮120行合成文件任务，正在运行时按Enter提交唯一第二消息；首轮结束后该消息独立应答。切为插话模式后对既有round-owned fixture做一次只读任务，运行中按Enter提交唯一第二消息；消息在首轮运行期间即显示，首轮完成后出现后续处理。只判定提交时序，不判定中断语义或任务文件输出。
恢复排队发送；先将焦点置于body且读取activeElement=BODY，再按一次Control+k；搜索会话输入仍隐藏，不重试。最终回读全部设置初值。
attempts.wait_condition: 等待各任务显示完成或已记录的最终界面状态；busy-send按首轮完成与第二消息回应先后判定；快捷键一次按键后检查搜索输入可见性。

checkpoints.observed: 应用内侧栏与默认浏览器对同一可见target链接分别发出Electron侧栏请求与Chrome请求；代码工具开启时本轮JS差异卡片/面板与Trace可见，关闭时差异/Trace入口不可见但工作区文件工具仍执行。设置恢复并回读。Agent预设切换另有独立gate未验证。

checkpoints.expected: 不把即时生效当所有设置通则
checkpoints.observed: Queue与Insert两次第二消息均提交，Queue在首轮结束后单独应答、Insert消息在首轮运行期间立即显示并在首轮结束后处理；只描述时序，不外推中断语义。一次Control+k合成事件未打开搜索，快捷键实体键盘效果未验证。

attempts.observed_result: 本轮四项有三项得到有限UI行为证据（目标路由、Trace/差异显示、繁忙消息时序）；Ctrl+K按键效果在一次合成事件中未触发搜索，保留未验证。
